notHappening.detail: No 2026 edition is announced. onlywatch.com shows the 10th edition (auctioned 10 May 2024, PALEXPO Geneva) as the most recent, and describes the event as biennial. Only Watch appears in neither of the two comprehensive 2026 watch-event calendars checked. Whether the cycle is formally paused or simply undeclared could not be verified.

Most likely not happening. The official site carries no 2026 announcement (latest edition: 19–23 Nov 2025), and two independent sources state the next edition returns in November 2027. One outlet claims an 8th edition on 18–22 Nov 2026 — treat that as low confidence and do not book on it.

expected.detail: 66–69 brands will launch product across 2–6 September. Bvlgari, MB&F, Urwerk, De Bethune, Ulysse Nardin, Girard-Perregaux and Breitling have historically debuted limited pieces here. Nothing specific has been published yet.
